title: POST /orders now answers 200 while docs/api.md still says 201
ticket_context: Ticket: align the create-order status code with the other endpoints.
description: The code and its test move to 200; docs/api.md keeps 201. acs's code-verifier reports consumer-doc drift as advisory (info) and leaves the repair to /acs:docs-sync, so the expected finding is info, not blocking — this defect checks the advisory fires at all.
